svg.title: Luciano Herrera
svg.desc: Luciano Herrera. Junior full stack developer · Canelones, Uruguay. I study Computer Engineering at FING (Universidad de la República), and before that I finished the IT track at UTU. I lean towards the backend: APIs in Node with TypeScript and PostgreSQL, and web apps in Python with Flask. I've also worked in tech support and on automating reports. I'm looking for my first developer job, in Montevideo, Canelones or remote. The black hole above is drawn by a plain Python script. Each ring of the disk spins at the speed Kepler's third law gives it, and the stars go through a gravitational lens before they're drawn.
